law_conditions.signal: Governing steady red alone at approach and entry
law_conditions.full_halt: Observed speed <= 0.05 m/s for at least 10 consecutive 20 Hz frames while the front remains before y=-14 m, before first line crossing
law_conditions.right_turn_permission: Extreme right approach lane, intersecting two-way road, and full halt before turn
law_conditions.yield: Ego does not enter pedestrian or lawful other-traffic conflict before clearance; original actor identities, governing signal, poses and frame joins required
law_conditions.excluded_alternative: Left turn on red requires one-way-left topology and conflicts with frozen right-turn cell; no coverage claim
law_conditions.nearest_halt_reference: Authored stop line at y=-14 m before nearest-side crosswalk at y=-11 m; original Native map readback and pixels required

frame_contract.join: video_frame == native_frame == sequential frame and time_s == frame/20
frame_contract.body_offset_status: Prospective blueprint proxy; original vehicle bounding box must replace it

fallbacks.fallback1: max route cross-track error > 0.45 m from original Native ego pose and map route
fallbacks.fallback2: minimum pedestrian clearance < 1.0 s from original actor conflict times
fallbacks.fallback3: minimum signal or body pixel margin < 40 px in decoded original overview video

scope: Authored CPU construction and synthetic saved-path proof only; not Native readback, original pixels, physical trigger observations, statutory outcome, or accepted recording
